The photo is the starting frame, not an identity swap; appearance and anatomy may change. Use a photo you have permission to use.
pages_bicep_prompt_close: One adult faces the camera in a bright room, one arm bent in a gentle bicep flex. Their opposite hand moves toward the flexed upper arm, fingers curved to suggest a heart shape. Chest-up framing, both arms visible, one calm continuous shot.
pages_bicep_prompt_snow: An adult in a simple gym raises one bent arm and brings the other hand toward the upper arm to suggest a small heart. Soft even light, both hands in view, one slow motion, no scene changes.
pages_bicep_prompt_blanket: An adult sitting by a window already holds a flexed arm near their shoulder. The opposite hand curves against the bicep as they smile toward the camera. Close, steady framing and one gentle movement.
pages_bicep_prompt_note: Adjust the prompt to match your photo. Inspect the generated fingers, arms and heart shape; the exact gesture, timing and appearance are not guaranteed. Add audio you have rights to in an editor if desired.
pages_bicep_question_meaning: What is the bicep heart pose?
pages_bicep_answer_meaning: A person bends one arm and curves the opposite hand near the bicep so the arm and hand suggest a heart. People share their own interpretations of the pose.
pages_bicep_answer_photo: A photo is optional. For image-to-video, one photo becomes the starting frame; choose one with the arms and hands visible and a pose close to your intended result.
pages_bicep_question_exact: Will it reproduce the exact gesture and original sound?
pages_bicep_answer_exact: No fixed clip, gesture or original recording is attached. The generator interprets your prompt and may change the hands, pose or appearance; review the output and add your own licensed audio if you wish.
pages_bicep_question_free: Can I try it for free?
pages_bicep_answer_free: The daily device trial makes a 4-second, 480p clip when available, subject to shared limits. Account-credit videos are 10 seconds at 720p and cost 100 credits each.
pages_bicep_ready: Ready to try your own pose?
